L., Wishart Common garage door repair questions How much do garage door repairs cost in Brisbane? + Garage door repairs in Brisbane typically range from a little over $100 for minor adjustments through to several hundred dollars when parts such as springs or motors need replacing. As an general guide, a service call-out is around $120 to $200, a torsion spring replacement around $220 to $450, and an opener or motor replacement around $600 to $1,100. The final cost depends on the door type, the extent of the fault and whether new components are required. The attending technician provides a written fixed-price quote before any work begins.
